transcript.answer: Pull request #475, "Hand the resolved fallback to HAL Engine, and refuse fallbacks it cannot serve", made FALLBACK_MODEL_ID reach HAL Engine's failover. It was merged on 2026-10-23 and closes issue #474. Before it, PR #438 (issue #179) only checked FALLBACK_MODEL_ID against the allowlist and printed it in the api.model startup line. buildEngine passed createHalEngine no fallbackProviders, and that is the only setting HAL Engine fails over through. PR #475 added supportAgentProviders(config) in apps/api/src/server.ts. It returns the resolved fallback as fallbackProviders, or [] when FALLBACK_MODEL_ID is unset, and buildEngine spreads it into createHalEngine. The PR also added enforceMockFallback in apps/api/src/configuration/models.ts, which refuses non-mock fallbacks at startup.
